ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.10:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (dark-grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark-grey field with stochastic distribution of high-contrast white punctate blobs (1-8 pixel clusters) across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 55 degrees with a vertical depth of roughly 12% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct macro-level semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately midway to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips of the fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of localized white circular pixel clusters, with higher density in the lower-medial portion of the left lobe and distal edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Low-contrast diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible across the central medial portion of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial traumatic notch indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive punctate scarring consistent with colonial barnacle attachment across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Ambient water spray and droplet artifacts partially occluding the pixel-level definition of the trailing edge boundary.
